review_method: Direct inspection of final source front, side, head close-up, three-quarter, grip close-up, and fresh-import GLB renders
findings: Functional short maintenance-mallet silhouette with square striking faces and no weapon embellishment.
Worn brown timber and dark dull iron remain visually distinct.
Corrosion/mineral coloration is restrained, with no marine growth.
Full-object front, side, and three-quarter views contain the complete asset; close-ups intentionally crop to their subject.
No visible holes, inverted faces, transparent cards, or disconnected floating components.
Fresh imported GLB preserves the form and embedded material response.
limitations: Dark iron finish is deliberately subdued and must be assessed under the target scene lighting later.
Low-poly cap/edge shading differs slightly between editable-source and imported triangulated views.
No final character-hand grip fit has been reviewed in this standalone tool package.
Visual inspection is not collision, attack-timing, or game-engine validation.
